name: delivrie
description: Add email to your app with Delivrie, and let your coding agent send test emails, verify domains, read logs and edit templates through Delivrie's MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Adds transactional email to your codebase with Delivrie: the right SDK for your language, a verified sender, idempotent sends, signed webhooks and test addresses. Connect your Delivrie account to send test emails, check domains and delivery logs, and edit templates from your editor.
interface.defaultPrompt: Add a welcome email to this app with Delivrie
